biggest_catch: Strict one-account-per-device rules with aggressive anti-fraud bans: VPNs, emulators, fake referrals, or duplicate accounts lead to permanent suspension and forfeited points — and there is no universal published minimum; gift cards are country-specific.
catches: One account per device; VPN/emulator/duplicate accounts = permanent ban and lost points.
PayPal payouts 'typically take 24-48 hours' but delays happen; first-time gift-card code delivery is locked for ~24 hours verification.
Gift card options vary by country; US users get Amazon, Google Play, Steam, Xbox, PlayStation cards.
No universal minimum payout published — the effective minimum is the cheapest reward in your country's catalog (PayPal from $3 per recent reviews).
User complaints about bans for innocuous activity are common — the anti-cheat is harsh.

steps: Install appKarma (Android/iOS) and sign up free.
Earn points by installing and trying sponsored apps, playing games, and completing surveys.
Keep one account per device; never use a VPN or emulator.
Reach the redemption minimum (PayPal from ~$3, gift cards from ~$5 depending on country).
Redeem for PayPal cash (24-48h) or a digital gift card (24h verification on first redemption).
